name: input
title: Input
purpose: Collect a short text, password, email, number, date, phone, monetary, or percentage value with an associated label.
avoidFor: Choosing from a fixed option list

composition.masking: Use a custom mask with # digit placeholders, type=phone for the built-in phone mask, type=monetary for localized currency display, or type=percentage for an editable numeric value with a persistent percent suffix. Monetary and percentage models remain numeric.
composition.styling: Consumer class and style attributes merge onto the native input while shared helpers preserve the Balsa field language.
composition.feedback: Hint and validation error are associated with aria-describedby.

accessibility: Always provide a unique id and visible label.
Invalid feedback exposes aria-invalid and role alert.
Loading disables the native control and exposes aria-busy.
commonMistakes: Using placeholder text as the only label.
Using error color without a text message.
